title: Financial Hub Integration - Expense Module
summary: Complete 3-phase financial integration connecting Invoice, Payroll, Workforce Settlement modules to the Expense module via DB triggers. Phase 1: Auto-sync triggers (settlement->expense on status='paid', payroll->expense on status='confirmed', invoice->revenue on status='paid') with backfill. Schema additions: type (expense/revenue), source_type (payroll/settlement/invoice/manual), source_id on expense_expenses. Phase 2: Financial Hub dashboard with Revenue vs Expense P&L chart, monthly P&L table, source breakdown, type/source filters on list view, auto-synced entry protection. Phase 3: expense_budgets table for budget planning, 3-month revenue forecast, CSV export (full/revenue/expense). Supabase project: fifuhkupaqcfjwyouwpa. Key files: ExpenseDashboard.tsx, ExpenseList.tsx, ExpenseReports.tsx, useExpenseState.ts, expenseService.ts. Invoice items use 'unitPrice' (not 'amount') for calculating totals.
